reviews.summary: Accepted all of snapshot v2. The round-1 blocker appeared untouched because the verdict crossed with the round-2 submission that fixed it. Judged D9's handling, bias direction and net-direction claim all correct, and supplied a stronger form of the keep-the-fold argument (nHat stuck at 1 collapses the decode externality to ~0, the same degeneration as the tau_e2e=0 trap). Confirmed the Consumes/body split, the two unguarded director panic paths are satisfied by the port's invariants, the bylabel value sets and allowsNoLabel asymmetry, apiVersion, ScoredCandidates, CachedBlockCount x BlockSizeTokens, nil Metrics handling, and pick-once. Restated that configload_test.go's tolerance is made safe by the construction-and-binding assertions after it rather than by the string match.
